_editing: The campaign boards on the homepage carousel — one designed slide per campaign theme. Each slide's artwork already carries its own headline and its four supporting lines, so the card is the image and nothing is re-typed over it. `alt` must therefore spell out every word baked into the artwork: it is the only copy a screen reader, or a visitor whose images failed to load, will ever get. `lines` is what the full-size viewer lists beneath the slide. `tone` (navy | red | gold) sets the ruled foot and the topic button, nothing more. Add or remove slides freely — the carousel measures itself and the topic strip builds from `category`.
